page.overview:
What is Pirate base?

This unmarked fortress ruin, located on the peninsula southwest of Refugees' Camp and northwest of Condyle in Velen, is the main base for pirates in the Spitfire Bluff area and their leader resides here along with approximately 10 other pirates.

Geralt can find Diagram: Griffin steel sword - enhanced here and he has to defeat the pirates and clear their bandit camp before a woman can appear at the nearby boatyard site, in order to start the the Love's Cruel Snares quest.

After clearing the camp and some time, a couple of students will appear here to excavate the site.
